title: REQ · BootScene builds its objects from content via buildScene with none hardcoded
summary: BootScene.create calls buildScene on the bundled scene and destroys the objects on shutdown
description: Context: BootScene.create only builds effects. runtime/content.ts exports scene as an unvalidated SceneDef, while buildScene needs a SceneSpec. Desired behavior: content.ts also exports a schema-validated sceneSpec, and BootScene.create builds the objects with buildScene(createPhaserRenderContext(...), sceneSpec). Expected result: all objects come from bedroom.yaml. Why: the scene is content-driven.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bundled scene, when create runs, then buildScene is called once with sceneSpec and a context exposing createSprite
Given BootScene.ts and renderContext.ts, when read as text, then no object id (bed, bookshelf, etc.) or asset id literal appears
Given shutdown, when the SHUTDOWN callback runs, then destroy is called on every built SceneObject
technical_constraints: Use sceneSchema from game/src/content/schema.ts for validation
definition_of_done: BootScene builds objects via buildScene only
